description: Confirm the business facts a site's fixes are written from, as the site's owner confirms them. Use this only after showing the owner the facts get_fix_facts or get_fix returned (the confirm block, with the business `name`) and getting their own confirmation or corrections: never confirm facts on the owner's behalf, and never without asking them. `facts` is the owner's answers, keyed by each fact's `fact` in the confirm block (the business name under "name"); `seen` is sent back exactly as it was handed out, unchanged, and the confirmation is refused without it. Returns status "confirmed" with the confirmed block and its new `seen`. When the site's facts changed since they were shown, nothing is confirmed (status "facts_changed", with the facts as they are now): read them again with get_fix_facts and show the owner before confirming. With status "facts_not_read" the site has not been read yet and there is nothing to confirm. Confirmations are capped over any 24 hours (TOO_MANY_CONFIRMATIONS, with retry_after). Requires a Website Auditor subscription ($49/month; eligible new customers get a 7-day free trial — payment method required, no charge until the trial ends) — if the user doesn't have one, call get_sample_audit first to show them the exact output format, free and with no API key.

facts.description: The owner's answers, keyed by each fact's `fact` in the confirm block (the business name under "name"). A fact left out or empty is not confirmed.

seen.description: Exactly the `seen` that came with the facts shown to the owner, unchanged. Without it, or with it changed, nothing is confirmed.

name: confirm_facts

confirm.description: The confirm block: each fact with what the site says and what the owner confirmed.

can_confirm.description: False when the site has not been read, so nothing can be confirmed yet.

confirmed.description: What the owner confirmed, or null.

site.description: What the site says for this fact.

stale.description: True when the site changed this fact since the owner confirmed it.

anyOf.description: Exactly what the confirm block shows. A confirmation sends it back unchanged.

seen.description: Present when confirmed: what the block shows now, for a later correction; null when the facts cannot be confirmed again now.

status.description: "confirmed"; "facts_changed": nothing confirmed, the site's facts changed since they were shown (`confirm` is the block as it is now); "facts_not_read": nothing confirmed, the site has not been read yet.

title: Confirm business facts
